description: Make cleaning more enjoyable with the Scotch-Brite Flex Scrub, a non-scratch kitchen sponge that rinses clean to help resist odors for a fresh clean every time. This scrub sponge features a temperature-controlled material that stays firm in cold water and soft in warm, providing the right clean when you need it. The soft, squeezable shape fits comfortably in your hand, and the center hole is perfect for cleaning utensils. It’s the perfect sponge for dishes, countertops, bathtubs, indoor and outdoor furniture, and more. It flexes into tight spaces and dries quickly by standing upright between uses. Follow use and care instructions on package. Do not use on stainless steel appliances or painted surfaces. For other surfaces, test first in a small hidden area and allow to dry to verify no surface damage. The product itself will not scratch but could pick up particles that will. Rinse thoroughly before and after use and squeeze dry. Safe to sanitize in the dishwasher up to 20X, it’s built to last and easy to refresh. Do not microwave and not for aquarium use. Scotch-Brite cleaning supplies give you the power to clean up life’s everyday messes - that’s why we’re America’s #1 selling scrub sponge brand. This Scotch-Brite cleaning tool does not protect users or others from food-borne or disease-causing bacteria
